name: Stadt Wien Veranstaltungen
notes: veranstaltungen.json (geojson) has no dates; real data comes from an Elasticsearch proxy at search.wien.gv.at/site_veranstaltungen/_search/template, POST {id:search_template_specific,params:{query_string,filters,from,size}} with Origin+Referer headers set to wien.gv.at (no API key needed once those are present, plain 'ApiKey ' auth header). One request returns all ~574 live events with structured occurrence dates (daoh_edit.logic.sets); single-type sets are exploded into one record per listed showtime, recurring/opening-hours sets collapse to one record spanning the range. price_min only set when 'Gratis' tag or a fixedPrice is given.
